channel.title: CTS journal
channel.description: Building CTS while looking for a job.

item.title: First numbers, and why this journal
item.description: 88 applications, 16 replies, 5 screening calls, and a recruiter who had already seen CTS.

item.title: What I will not automate
item.description: LinkedIn stays manual. Why, and what CTS uses instead.

item.title: Agents fill the form, I press Submit
item.description: An agent fills the application form in a browser tab and stops. Human in the loop, by design.

item.title: An A/B test on my own CV
item.description: Half of my applications get a CV adapted to the posting, half get the standard one. A coin decides.

item.title: People before postings
item.description: The first full week went into people and events, not applications. Why, and what it gave.

item.title: The CV is a build artifact
item.description: A CV assembled from approved blocks, tested by real parsers, and a lesson about AI text detectors.

item.title: 14,000 postings on day one
item.description: A registry of companies, a rules engine, monitoring and a database, built in one day with AI agents.

item.title: Research first, then a hub
item.description: Three days of market research, a look at career-ops, and the decision to build my own system.
